description:
We are looking for an experienced Deputy Plant Director to support the overall management and development of a high-precision manufacturing facility producing advanced thin-film heating solutions for automotive applications, including heating components for automotive cameras and other next-generation vehicle systems.
This is a senior leadership position with responsibility across Production, Quality, NPI, Process Engineering, and Manufacturing Excellence. The successful candidate will play a key role in improving plant performance, strengthening manufacturing capabilities, and supporting the ramp-up of new automotive products.
Core Responsibilities:
* Oversee Production, Quality, and New Product Development, ensuring performance meets plant, customer, and automotive quality requirements.
* Lead production efficiency and capacity improvement, including line balancing, manpower optimization, OEE, yield, and productivity.
* Drive process capability and quality improvement, with a focus on Cpk enhancement, defect reduction, process stability, and FPCB wet chemical processes.
* Lead the industrialization and mass-production ramp-up of new products, particularly thin-film heater products for automotive camera applications.
* Drive semi-automation, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives to improve manufacturing efficiency, quality, and cost competitiveness.
* Lead and develop cross-functional teams while supporting IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, customer audits, and technical/customer coordination.
requirements_text:
* Minimum 15+ years of solid experience in FPCB or precision electronics manufacturing, ideally with top-tier multinationals or Tier-1 vendors.
* Deep technical understanding of FPCB wet chemical processes (chemical etching, undercut/etch-factor control, line yield optimization) and automotive quality systems (IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP).
* Fluent business English (mandatory for direct reporting, technical coordination, and customer audit defence).
* Able to commute daily or relocate to Binh Duong (My Phuoc 3).
